skillFull: Enters the Greenhouse of Memories at given intervals. Inside the Greenhouse is an unfinished Stained Glass, as well as Memory Flowers that appear at given intervals. When close to a flower, the Slide button changes to a Flower button. Press the Flower button to take a closer look at the flower. After sufficient observation, Fragmented Memories will be released from the flower. The Fragmented Memories fly to the Stained Glass, filling in the matching slot. Collecting all Fragmented Memories and finishing the Stained Glass makes light shine through, creating Sugarglass Shard Jellies. Level Up for more Flower Observation Points, and more points for Sugarglass Shard Jellies.
story:
A lone greenhouse built with stained glass, containing the history of the wizards, shines brilliantly upon the horizon. Within this mysterious greenhouse lies the Labyrinth of Remembrance and its watcher, Sugar Glass Cookie.

With transparent wings delicately stitched together with sugar glass, the caretaker floats quietly through the air and tends to the memories blooming inside the greenhouse's flowers. With the utmost care, the Labyrinth Watcher checks to see if these visions of the past are forming perfectly. A gentle-natured and fragile Cookie, her heart grieves all day when discovering a withered petal.

As the years have passed, the greenhouse's stained glass windows have also deteriorated, some beyond repair. But Sugar Glass Cookie, with wings as bright as the sun, continues to keep watch. She often looks up at the endless panes of glass for an answer... but the wizards remain silent as always.

costumes.info: Sugar Glass Cookie has decided to travel the universe in search of more memories. With each star and planet she visits, she has created stunning scenes of various memories immortalized in stained glass. The Golden Rose Window of Planet Allulose is said to be one of her creations as well. And yet, why is it that amidst such grandeur, one feels a faint chill...? Perhaps within the glass, the carefully hidden feelings of someone who calls Planet Allulose their home has found its way into the window...
